title: The Slow Machine
author: Noor Crane
blurb: Marguerite Thackeray, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
